items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the Gysin pullback of a flat pullback along the restriction of the morphism to a relative effective Cartier divisor, and deduces the corresponding expression for the cap with the first Chern class (statement lines 5597-5615, tag 02TR-adjacent). The proof reduces to an integral class, uses the relative Cartier property and the easy Gysin computation to identify the two classes as cycles, sums over a general cycle, and then deduces the second formula from the first. The reduction and the summation are the substance, so the claim is H2.
